Persistent compilation cache

Source: R/compilation_cache.R
experimental_compilation_cache_set_cache_dir.Rd

Ports of jax.experimental.compilation_cache.compilation_cache.set_cache_dir and reset_cache. With a cache directory set (here, or with the option jax_compilation_cache_dir of jax_config_update()), compiled programs are written to the directory and read back instead of being compiled again, also by later R sessions. As in JAX, only programs whose compilation took at least jax_persistent_cache_min_compile_time_secs seconds (default 1) are written, and jax_enable_compilation_cache = FALSE turns the cache off. Programs with host callbacks are not cached. Problems with the cache are warnings unless jax_raise_persistent_cache_errors is TRUE.

Usage

experimental_compilation_cache_set_cache_dir(path)

experimental_compilation_cache_reset_cache()

Arguments

path

Directory of the cache.

Value

NULL, invisibly.

Details

The cache is trusted: a cached file is native code that is run. Do not use a directory that others can write to.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
experimental_compilation_cache_set_cache_dir(file.path(tempdir(), "jax_cache"))
} # }
